answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 45843 Country: Pakistan Title: tahara (wadu) Question: I need the answer that according to Shariah, when someone makes laughter loudly except in the prayer (namaz) so does it invalidates our wudhu or not? Answer ID: 45843 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 932/733/B=1434) No, it does not break wudhu, but if someone laughs loudly during salah it shall invalidate both salah and wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
